# ADR NNNN – Short title

- **Status:** Proposed | Accepted | Rejected | Superseded by ADR-NNNN
- **Date:** YYYY-MM-DD
- **Deciders:** names or roles
- **Related questions:** Q-NNN, if any

## Context

What situation requires a decision? Include constraints, forces and the cost of
not deciding. Link to the owning documents rather than repeating them.

## Decision

State the choice in one or two sentences. Be specific enough that someone can
tell whether an implementation follows it.

## Alternatives considered

| Alternative | Why it was not chosen |
|---|---|
| Option A | Reason |
| Option B | Reason |

## Consequences

- **Positive:** what becomes easier.
- **Negative:** what becomes harder or is given up.
- **Follow-up:** documents, migrations or questions that must change.

## Review

When should this decision be revisited? What would invalidate it?
